School x is my third choice and I have priority 2 at x.
School w is my last choice and I have priority 1 at w.

Since I have priority 1 at both y and w, these schools are guaranteed to be in my obtainable set. I prefer y to w, so I should rank y first. Since w is guaranteed to be in my obtainable set, I should rank w last since it is my least preferred.

Now I need to decide how to rank z and x, where I have priority 2 at both. I prefer z to x, so I should rank z higher than x. Thus, I should rank z second and x third.

Therefore, my ranking should be y > z > x > w.
